meta.title: Costco's Best-Selling Brand Is Costco. Kirkland Does $90 Billion A Year.
meta.hook: Kirkland Signature gives Costco something national brands cannot: a product it controls from shelf price to customer promise.
meta.description: Kirkland Signature, Costco's house brand, generates an estimated $90 billion a year and accounts for roughly a quarter to a third of Costco's total merchandise sales as of fiscal 2025. Many Kirkland products are made by the same manufacturers as the name-brand version sitting next to them on the shelf, priced lower because there's no separate marketing budget to fund. Educational content only, not financial advice.

scenes.narration: Kirkland Signature gives Costco something national brands cannot: a product it controls from shelf price to customer promise.

visual.query: warehouse store shelf packaged goods close up
visual.visual_intent: A close-up shelf sweep across packaged warehouse-store goods, dense and abundant
visual.decision_reason: hook beat: Kirkland's ~28-33% share of Costco sales, hard cut

scenes.narration: Costco identifies Kirkland as its private-label brand and says it invests heavily in developing and protecting it.

visual.query: generic store brand product packaging shelf
visual.visual_intent: A clean, simple store-brand product package on a shelf, understated but premium-feeling

scenes.narration: A private label lets the retailer define specifications, choose suppliers, and sell under a name competitors cannot carry.

visual.visual_intent: A production line packaging identical-looking goods in bulk, industrial and precise
visual.decision_reason: widely reported practice in retail/private-label industry coverage (Motley Fool, PLMA)

scenes.narration: That creates a direct comparison on the same shelf: a familiar national brand beside Costco's own alternative.

visual.query: price tag comparison shelf close up
visual.visual_intent: Two price tags side by side on a shelf, one visibly lower, simple direct comparison
visual.decision_reason: explains the structural cost advantage of house brands

scenes.narration: If members trust Kirkland, Costco can use one brand across groceries, clothing, household goods, and many other categories.

visual.query: financial chart bars rising screen dark
visual.visual_intent: A single glowing bar rising dramatically taller than the rest on a dark financial display
visual.decision_reason: estimated ~$90B FY2025 figure reported across multiple retail-industry sources (Motley Fool, readtrung)

scenes.narration: The strategy turns shelf space into an owned asset. Costco is not only choosing products; it is building a brand available only to members.

visual.query: warehouse store aisle wide shot shoppers
visual.visual_intent: A wide shot of a busy warehouse-store aisle, scale and volume, closing image
